title: 第1157章 死客登舟第1156章 乾坤颠倒
slug: 双修暴击十万次仙子倒贴求放过
content_zh:
那具已经压成一团，胸骨从背后刺出，血还未落地便被瀑布吸走。
围在崖边的人齐齐后退。
就在这时，顾平袖中灵犀玉符亮起，苏晚棠的字迹一行行浮在掌心。
南泽旧渡口位于古湖西南角，湖水升空后，渡口也被带上云层。
古渡边上每隔一刻就会有船靠岸，大湖只载身带死气之人。
活人强登，沉湖压骨。
苍梧一行十一人，领头者墨寒川，苍梧湖库掌事，渡劫后期。
其余十人皆在炼虚境以上。
只有古渡的船头血灯可借死人气息遮住活气，他们已经过了第一处云岸。
顾平看完，暗红字迹又补出一句。
苍梧祖地的湖库，原是南泽古湖流出去的一条支湖。
南泽封没前，苍梧先祖截断支湖，取支湖水眼炼成一枚苍梧湖库令。
墨寒川把湖库令带进了南泽。
如今南泽重现，同源水脉重新接通。
湖库令可以借来部分南泽水势，调动旧渡水路，也能打开南泽里的沉城外门。
这枚令牌承的是支湖旧权，即便碰不到镇压南泽的定界古印，有这样的历史渊源，想必苍梧家找到南泽的定界古印，或许也会很简单了。
想到那东陵的定界古印上的秘密。
顾平也就加快了脚步。
叶青篱看着他掌心：“现在有人给你传消息？”
“债主催命。”

顾平收起玉符，转身沿崖边往西南走。叶青篱跟上两步，言语之中很是惊喜：“你知道从哪里进去吗？”
“现在知道了。”
顾平在前面带路，两人绕开升空瀑布，顺着一条刚露出地面的古堤疾行。
堤下埋着腐烂船骨，残桨从土中伸出，桨叶全朝向天空。
越往前，水腥气越重。
数十里后，古堤陡然向天上折起，像一条靠在天上，升天的石梯。
尽头悬着半座渡口，古堤的岸桩横在云层边缘，下面垂着成百上千条铁索。
铁索末端全系着尸体。
有的只剩白骨，有的衣袍还算完整，湖风一吹，尸身便在云下互相碰撞。
骨头磕响和铁链摩擦混在一起，让整个渡口像一架生锈风铃。
岸边已经聚了近千名修士，炼虚境气机彼此挤压，云下时而浮出法相与洞天虚影。
各家都在试探登船办法。
content_en:
The body had been crushed into a ball, the sternum was pierced from the back, and the blood was sucked away by the waterfall before it even hit the ground.
The people surrounding the cliff all retreated.
At this moment, the jade charm in Gu Ping's sleeve lit up, and Su Wantang's handwriting floated line by line in his palm.
Nanze Old Ferry is located in the southwest corner of the ancient lake. After the lake water rises into the sky, the ferry is also carried up into the clouds.
There are boats docking every other moment on the ancient ferry, and the big lake only carries people with a sense of death.
A living person can climb up by force, and sink into a lake with his bones crushed.
Cang Wu and his party of eleven were led by Mo Hanchuan, who was in charge of the Cang Wu Lake Treasury and was in the later stages of the Tribulation.
The remaining ten people are all above the Void Refining Realm.
Only the blood lantern on the bow of the ancient ferry could use the breath of the dead to cover up the vitality. They had already passed the first cloud bank.
After Gu Ping finished reading, he added another sentence in dark red handwriting.
The lake in Cangwu's ancestral land was originally a branch lake flowing out of Nanze Ancient Lake.
Before Nanze was sealed off, Cangwu's ancestors cut off Zhihu Lake and took the water eye of Zhihu Lake to make a Cangwu Lake Kuling.
Mo Hanchuan brought Hu Kuling into Nanze.
Now Nanze has reappeared, and the water veins from the same source have been reconnected.
Hukuling can borrow part of Nanze's water potential, mobilize the old water crossing, and also open the outer gate of Nanze's sinking city.
This token inherits the old power of Zhihu. Even if it cannot encounter the ancient boundary seal that suppressed Nanze, with such a historical origin, it may be easy for the Cangwu family to find the ancient boundary seal of Nanze.
Thinking of the secret on the ancient boundary seal of Dongling.
Gu Ping also quickened his pace.
Ye Qingli looked at his palm: "Is someone sending you a message now?"
"The creditor urges you."
Gu Ping put away the jade talisman, turned around and walked southwest along the cliff. Ye Qingli followed two steps forward and said with great surprise: "Do you know where to go in?"
"I know now."
Gu Ping led the way, and the two of them bypassed the Ascension Waterfall and hurried along an ancient embankment that had just emerged from the ground.
There are rotten ship bones buried under the embankment, and the remaining oar sticks out from the soil, with all the blades facing the sky.
The further you go, the more fishy the water becomes.
Tens of miles later, the ancient embankment suddenly folded toward the sky, like a stone staircase leaning against the sky and ascending to the sky.
Half of the ferry hangs at the end. The bank piles of the ancient embankment lie across the edge of the clouds, with hundreds of iron cables hanging below.
The ends of the iron ropes were all tied with corpses.
Some only have bones left, while some still have intact robes. When the lake wind blows, the corpses collide with each other under the clouds.
The crackling of bones and the friction of iron chains mixed together, making the entire ferry look like a rusty wind chime.
Nearly a thousand monks have gathered on the shore. The qi machines in the Void Refining Realm are squeezing each other, and dharma images and phantoms in the cave sky sometimes appear under the clouds.
Everyone is trying to find ways to board the ship.
